### Toast Announces Participation at Goldman Sachs Communacopia & Technology Conference


08/26/2026


BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Toast (NYSE: TOST), the global technology platform built for restaurant and retail businesses, today announced its management team will present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia & Technology Conference in San Francisco, CA on Wednesday, September 9, 2026 at 8:50 a.m. PST. A webcast of the company presentation will be available on Toast's Investor Relations website at[https://investors.toasttab.com/overview/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.toasttab.com%2Foverview%2F&esheet=54592043&newsitemid=20260826685319&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.toasttab.com%2Foverview%2F&index=1&md5=476c890cd59c726044072f726486477c) .


**About Toast**


Toast \[NYSE: TOST\] is a global technology platform built for restaurant and retail businesses. From the busiest local restaurants and shops to large hospitality brands, Toast helps owners and operators manage their businesses more efficiently, drive guest demand, and build lasting success.


Toast integrates software, agentic AI, payments, financial technology solutions, and hardware with a broad partner ecosystem. Powering billions of purchases throughout local commerce, Toast delivers the precision and innovation required for modern restaurant and retail environments. For more information, visit[www.toasttab.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.toasttab.com&esheet=54592043&newsitemid=20260826685319&lan=en-US&anchor=www.toasttab.com&index=2&md5=39cff486ee70be8f355a6304d97c2b13) .
